content.title: Egypt Discovery & Red Sea Escape
content.summary: An 11-day private guided journey through Cairo, Aswan, Luxor and Hurghada, with Abu Simbel, a three-night Nile cruise, Red Sea relaxation and a farewell dinner cruise in Cairo.
content.description:
Experience the extraordinary diversity of Egypt on an unforgettable 11-day journey combining ancient wonders, fascinating cultural heritage, a relaxing Nile cruise, and the beautiful shores of the Red Sea.

From standing before the legendary Pyramids of Giza to exploring the magnificent temples of Abu Simbel and sailing along the timeless Nile, this carefully planned private journey introduces you to Egypt’s most remarkable destinations while allowing time to enjoy its landscapes and atmosphere.

Your adventure begins in Cairo, where thousands of years of history come to life. Discover the Great Pyramids and the Sphinx, explore the treasures of the Egyptian Museum, and uncover the rich religious and architectural heritage of Islamic and Coptic Cairo. Wander through the colorful Khan el-Khalili bazaar before boarding an overnight sleeper train to Aswan.

In southern Egypt, admire the beautiful Philae Temple, experience the tranquility of a traditional felucca sail at sunset, and visit the monumental rock-cut temples of Abu Simbel. Then embark on a three-night Nile cruise, traveling from Aswan towards Luxor through a landscape of palm groves, traditional villages, and historic temples.

Along the way, discover the remarkable temples of Kom Ombo and Edfu before arriving in Luxor, where the royal tombs of the Valley of the Kings and the magnificent Temple of Queen Hatshepsut reveal the extraordinary achievements of ancient Egyptian civilization.

Your journey then takes a different pace as you travel to Hurghada on the Red Sea coast. Enjoy the seaside atmosphere and time to relax before returning to Cairo.

To complete your Egyptian experience, spend a leisurely final day in the capital, followed by an evening Nile dinner cruise featuring a buffet and live entertainment - a memorable conclusion to a journey filled with history, culture, and discovery.

With private transportation, guided sightseeing, carefully arranged accommodation, a three-night Nile cruise, and a combination of cultural experiences and relaxation, this itinerary offers a comprehensive way to discover Egypt in just 11 days.

All meals are included, from dinner on arrival day through breakfast on departure day. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included on every full day in between.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Cairo
itinerary.description:
Your Egyptian adventure begins the moment you arrive at Cairo International Airport. Our representative will welcome you, assist with your arrival arrangements, and accompany you to your private vehicle for a comfortable transfer to your hotel. After check-in, take some time to settle into your surroundings. Depending on your arrival time, enjoy a brief introductory tour of Cairo or simply relax at your hotel before the exciting days ahead.

Meals: Dinner | Overnight: Cairo hotel | Night 1

itinerary.title: The Great Pyramids, Sphinx & Egyptian Museum
itinerary.description:
Today, step into the world of the ancient pharaohs as you explore one of the most celebrated archaeological sites on Earth. Accompanied by your professional guide, travel to the Giza Plateau to admire the magnificent Great Pyramids, extraordinary monuments that have stood for thousands of years. Continue to the Great Sphinx, the iconic guardian of the plateau, whose mysterious expression has fascinated generations of travelers. Your exploration of ancient Egyptian civilization continues at the Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square, home to an extraordinary collection of artifacts that illuminate the country’s remarkable history. After lunch at a local restaurant, return to your hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Cairo hotel | Night 2

itinerary.title: Museums, Islamic & Coptic Cairo
itinerary.description:
Discover Cairo beyond the pyramids as you explore the city’s fascinating layers of religious, cultural, and architectural history. Begin at the National Museum of Egyptian Civilization, where Egypt’s heritage unfolds across different periods of its history. Continue to the impressive Mosque of Sultan Hassan and the neighboring Al-Rifa’i Mosque, two outstanding landmarks of Islamic Cairo. Following lunch at a local restaurant, explore the historic streets of Old Cairo and visit some of its most important religious sites, including the Hanging Church, the Church of St. Sergius and Bacchus (Abu Serga), the Church of St. George, and the Mosque of Amr ibn al-As. In the evening, experience the lively atmosphere of Khan el-Khalili bazaar, known for its traditional shops, narrow lanes, and rich local character. Afterwards, transfer to Cairo Railway Station to board your overnight sleeper train to Aswan. Enjoy dinner on board as your journey continues south.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Sleeper train | Night 3

itinerary.title: Aswan, Philae Temple & Sunset Felucca Sailing
itinerary.description:
Wake up to the landscapes of Upper Egypt and enjoy breakfast aboard the sleeper train before arriving in Aswan, one of the Nile Valley’s most picturesque cities. Meet your representative at the railway station and begin exploring Aswan’s highlights. Visit the impressive Aswan High Dam before continuing to the enchanting Philae Temple, dedicated to the goddess Isis and beautifully situated on an island in the Nile. After lunch at a local restaurant, transfer to your Aswan hotel for check-in. As the afternoon draws to a close, enjoy one of Egypt’s most atmospheric experiences: a traditional felucca sail on the Nile at sunset. Feel the gentle breeze and admire the surrounding river scenery as you glide across the water. Later in the evening, explore Aswan’s local market, where traditional goods and everyday local life create a lively setting.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Aswan hotel | Night 4

itinerary.title: Abu Simbel & Your Nile Cruise Begins
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with an early departure by private vehicle to one of Egypt’s most extraordinary archaeological treasures: the magnificent temples of Abu Simbel. Carved into the rock during the reign of Ramesses II, these monumental temples are among the greatest achievements of ancient Egyptian architecture. Stand before the colossal statues guarding the Great Temple and discover the remarkable scale and history of this extraordinary site. After your visit, return to Aswan and transfer to your Nile cruise ship, where the next chapter of your Egyptian journey begins. Settle into your accommodation and enjoy lunch and dinner on board. Your first night aboard the cruise ship is spent in Aswan.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Nile cruise, Aswan | Night 5

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise, Kom Ombo & Sailing to Edfu
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast aboard your Nile cruise before continuing through the timeless landscapes of Upper Egypt. Sail towards Kom Ombo, where you will visit one of Egypt’s most distinctive ancient temples. Dedicated to Sobek, the crocodile god, and Haroeris, or Horus the Elder, Kom Ombo is celebrated for its unusual double-temple design and fascinating carved reliefs. After exploring the temple, return to your cruise ship and continue sailing towards Edfu. Spend time relaxing aboard the ship, enjoying the facilities and watching the scenery of the Nile Valley unfold around you. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are served on board, with an overnight stay in Edfu.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Nile cruise, Edfu | Night 6

itinerary.title: Edfu Temple & Sailing to Luxor
itinerary.description:
Continue your journey through ancient Egypt with a visit to the impressive Temple of Horus at Edfu, one of the best-preserved temples in the country. Dedicated to the falcon-headed god Horus, this magnificent sanctuary offers a fascinating introduction to the religious beliefs, architectural achievements, and ceremonial traditions of ancient Egypt. Following your visit, return to the cruise ship and continue sailing towards Luxor. Enjoy the changing scenery of the Nile Valley, from green agricultural fields and palm-lined riverbanks to traditional villages that reflect the enduring connection between the Egyptian people and the river. Arrive in Luxor for your final night aboard the Nile cruise.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Nile cruise, Luxor | Night 7

itinerary.title: Luxor’s Royal Tombs & Journey to the Red Sea
itinerary.description:
After breakfast aboard your Nile cruise, discover the archaeological treasures of Luxor’s legendary West Bank. Begin with the Valley of the Kings, the famous burial ground of the New Kingdom pharaohs, where magnificent royal tombs were carved deep into the desert hills. Continue to the spectacular Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, one of Egypt’s most distinctive ancient monuments, built against the dramatic limestone cliffs of Deir el-Bahari. Following your sightseeing and disembarkation from the Nile cruise, meet your private driver for the overland journey to Hurghada on the Red Sea coast. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening at leisure, surrounded by the atmosphere of Egypt’s popular seaside destination.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Hurghada hotel | Night 8

itinerary.title: Hurghada Leisure & Return to Cairo
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a change of pace as you wake up beside the beautiful Red Sea. After breakfast at your Hurghada hotel, spend time relaxing and enjoying the coastal atmosphere. Whether you prefer to unwind by the sea or simply appreciate a quieter morning, this is an opportunity to recharge after your days of cultural exploration. For travelers wishing to experience more of the Red Sea, an optional marine or boat excursion may be arranged at an additional cost. Following your leisure time, meet your private driver for the journey back to Cairo. Upon arrival in the capital, check in to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

Dinner is served at the Hurghada hotel before departure for Cairo.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Cairo hotel | Night 9

itinerary.title: Cairo at Leisure & Evening Nile Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at your Cairo hotel and spend the morning and afternoon at your own pace. Relax at the hotel, explore the city independently, or arrange an optional sightseeing excursion to discover more of Cairo. In the evening, enjoy a special farewell experience on the Nile. Meet your representative for a private transfer to your Nile dinner cruise, where you will board a riverboat for an enjoyable evening sailing through Cairo. Savor a buffet dinner while admiring the illuminated riverfront and enjoying live onboard entertainment. Depending on the cruise operator’s scheduled program, performances may include Egyptian music, traditional Tanoura dancing, and other live shows. After the cruise, return comfortably to your hotel by private transfer for your final night in Egypt.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Cairo hotel | Night 10

itinerary.title: Farewell Egypt & Final Departure
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel as your memorable Egyptian journey comes to an end. Depending on your international flight schedule, enjoy some free time before checking out. At the appropriate time, your private vehicle will transfer you to Cairo International Airport for your departure. Leave Egypt with lasting memories of its legendary pyramids, extraordinary temples, peaceful Nile landscapes, Red Sea coastline, and the remarkable history and culture encountered along the way.

Meals: Breakfast | End of tour

inclusions: 3 nights aboard a Nile cruise ship with full-board meals.
1 night aboard the Cairo–Aswan sleeper train.
Meet-and-assist services on arrival and departure.
Airport and railway station transfers with hotel pick-up and drop-off.
Private overland transportation for the Abu Simbel excursion.
Private transfer from Luxor to Hurghada.
Private transfer from Hurghada to Cairo.
Domestic transportation as specified in the itinerary.
Licensed Egyptologist guide throughout the excursions.
Guided sightseeing and entrance fees to all mentioned sites.

Cairo sightseeing: Giza Pyramids and Sphinx, Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square, National Museum of Egyptian Civilization, Mosques of Sultan Hassan and Al-Rifa’i, Old Cairo religious landmarks and Khan el-Khalili.
Upper Egypt sightseeing: Aswan High Dam, Philae Temple, Abu Simbel, Kom Ombo Temple, Edfu Temple, Valley of the Kings and Temple of Queen Hatshepsut.
Traditional felucca sailing experience in Aswan.
Cairo Nile dinner cruise on Day 10, including buffet dinner, scheduled live entertainment and private round-trip hotel transfers.
All meals from dinner on arrival day through breakfast on departure day, including breakfast, lunch and dinner on each full day in between.
exclusions: International flights and Egypt entry visa.
Optional Red Sea marine or boat excursions in Hurghada.
Optional sightseeing or activities on Day 10.
Any services not specifically mentioned in the itinerary.
content.bookingTerms:
Availability
Tours are available throughout the year except from 24 December to 7 January, inclusive. All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation.

Payment
A deposit of 25% of the total tour price is required upon confirmation. The remaining balance must be paid 30 days before departure.

Cancellation
Cancellation charges are calculated as a percentage of the total tour price, based on the number of days before departure when cancellation is received:
• 60 or more days: no cancellation charge; full refund.
• 59–30 days: 25% of the total tour price.
• 29–15 days: 50% of the total tour price.
• 14–7 days: 75% of the total tour price.
• 6 days or fewer: 100% of the total tour price.
Any refund or outstanding cancellation charge is calculated against the amount already paid.

Children’s policy
Children under 2 years old: free of charge.
Children aged 2 to under 6: 25% of the applicable adult tour price.
Children aged 6 to under 12: 50% of the applicable adult tour price.
Travelers aged 12 or older: full adult tour price.
These child rates apply when sharing a room with parents, with a maximum of one child sharing the parents’ room. If a tour includes airfare, additional child airfare charges may apply. Please contact us to confirm room arrangements and a family quote; the online group-rate calculator currently uses full adult rates.

Date changes
Date changes are available, subject to availability. Administration fees may apply depending on the travel period for which the tour is booked. Please contact us to confirm available dates and any applicable fees before a change is made.

Force majeure
We offer a flexible cancellation approach when travel is affected by circumstances beyond the traveler's control, such as government restrictions, airline disruptions, official do-not-travel warnings, war or civil unrest. Each case is reviewed individually, taking into account the circumstances and applicable supplier arrangements. Please contact us promptly to discuss available cancellation or rescheduling options.
